title: Run HO19 / Renew Run woman running

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Run Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Show the product in both motion and a resting stance so viewers can connect activity with visible footwear detail.
strategic_value: The running scene and pink-accented shoe close-up can make Renew Run feel usable without losing product specificity.
demonstration: A woman in a blue top runs beside a railing; the inset shows black shoes with pink heel accents, and the outlined Swoosh joins the two photographs.
practical_value: Choose a secondary image that reveals product details the full-body photograph makes small.

content_islands.name: Copy column
content_islands.spec: Position the product name, supporting line and small black Swoosh low in the white left field.

content_islands.name: Running view
content_islands.spec: Use the runner, railing and city backdrop as the main photograph.

content_islands.name: Detail view
content_islands.spec: Overlap a shoe-and-railing photograph at right, with a white outline Swoosh crossing the image pair.
